frozen_gate.limit_rationale: donor SD planted at 0.5 x the smallest realistic value (Q01), or with about 1 positive cell per donor (Q08 positive), or under a residual SD of about 1.46 (Q09 positive): the posterior mean of a weakly identified SD sits above a small truth under any proper prior. A failure is reported as a limit on what a small real donor-SD estimate means; calibration (coverage) remains a FAIL-class gate
